link.fallback: Or paste this link into your browser:
verify_email.subject: Verify your email
verify_email.body: Confirm this address to finish setting up your GGE Bot account. The link works for 24 hours.
reset_password.subject: Reset your password
reset_password.body: We got a request to reset your GGE Bot password. The link works for 1 hour. If this wasn't you, ignore this email.
password_changed.subject: Your password was changed
password_changed.body: The password on your GGE Bot account was just changed and other devices were signed out. If this wasn't you, reset your password right away.
change_email.subject: Confirm your new email
change_email.body: Confirm this address to make it the email on your GGE Bot account. The link works for 1 hour. Confirming signs you out everywhere, and you sign in again with this address.
email_change_requested.subject: Someone asked to change your email
email_change_requested.asked: Someone who knows your GGE Bot password asked to change your account's email to {{newEmail}}. Nothing changes until that address confirms.
email_change_requested.advice: If this wasn't you, change your password right away. That signs out every other device.
email_changed.subject: Your email was changed
email_changed.body: The email on your GGE Bot account is now {{newEmail}}. This address no longer signs in or receives account emails, and every device was signed out.
email_changed.advice: If this wasn't you, contact the administrator of this GGE Bot server.
account_deleted.subject: Your account was deleted
account_deleted.body: Your GGE Bot account {{username}} was deleted, along with its game accounts, settings, logs and notifications. Its bots are stopping.
account_deleted.advice: If this wasn't you, contact the administrator of this GGE Bot server.
recovery_code_used.subject: A recovery code was used to sign in
recovery_code_used.body: Someone just signed in to the GGE Bot admin app with your password and one of your recovery codes, in place of an authenticator code.
recovery_code_used.remaining_one: You have {{count}} recovery code left. Make new ones under Settings in the admin app.
recovery_code_used.remaining_other: You have {{count}} recovery codes left. Make new ones under Settings in the admin app.
recovery_code_used.advice: If this wasn't you, reset your password right away and ask another admin to reset your two-factor sign-in.
bot_alerts.introPlan: Here is the latest on your GGE Bot account.
bot_alerts.introOneBot: A bot on your GGE Bot account stopped and won't start again until you act.
bot_alerts.introManyBots: These bots on your GGE Bot account stopped and won't start again until you act.
bot_alerts.subjectMixed_other: {{count}} updates on your GGE Bot account
bot_alerts.subjectMixed_one: {{count}} updates on your GGE Bot account
bot_alerts.footer: You can choose which of these emails you get under Settings.
